remarks: Charming townhouse at the footsteps to downtown Stamford! Two-floor living with washer/dryer in the unit. Gas heat, central AC, and a hop, skip and a jump to Scalzi Park. (Sq. ft. is approximate, please measure if you need exact sq. ft.) No pets. Pictures are of a similar unit.
